title: Enterprise Connectivity: correction object identity
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this correction object identity rule to assisted correction posting.

## Basis: selected authorization
For assisted correction posting, the assisted payout cycle handles the latest pending refund authorization on the selected holding by occurrence time; its latest timestamp must be unique, and its exact request identifier fixes the authorization throughout this cycle.

## Basis: selected assessment
For assisted correction posting, read related-review reference from that exact pending refund authorization to identify the rate-error review; unrelated historical reviews are not selected.

## Basis: selected original charge
For assisted correction posting, read source-event reference from that exact rate-error review to identify the original charge; the authorization's source payment must also refer to this same charge.

## Basis Q&A
| Assisted correction posting basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Assisted correction posting: Read source-event reference from that exact rate-error review to identify the original charge | the authorization's source payment must also refer to this same charge. |
